content:
ada: heads up — promo stuck. deploybot artifact-verify exited early (code 78) for build 2024.06.15-rc3. blocking promote.

deploy-bot: [ALERT] artifact-verify failed: exit code 78. Logs show checksum/read errors for blob layer 3/7.

ben: on it, checking logs and storage.

ben: tail from CI runner:
```
verify: layer 3 read: unexpected EOF
rsync: connection reset by peer
```

cara: we rotated the signer metadata last night. could be metadata etag mismatch pointing to wrong blob.

dmitri: unexpected EOF usually means truncated upload / multipart part lost. could be storage-level issue. checking object size and ETag vs manifest.

ben: re-running artifact-verify with `--skip-fast-check` to force full multipart download (so we see exact failing part).

deploy-bot: re-run requested by ben (job id: verify-1719991200). started at 1719991200.

ben: re-run failed at same spot, during download-part-3.

cara: registry logs show a push complete at 1719990000 for that digest. but index entry might be corrupted.

dmitri: quick unblock option: promote last-known-good digest `sha256:abc123def456` instead of this new digest. that's essentially a rollback to previous image.

release-coordinator: note — we're inside change window until 18:00 UTC. emergency rollback requires PM sign-off unless it's blocking production.

ada: PM gave verbal OK in DMs. proceed with emergency rollback/pin to sha256:abc123def456. create follow-up postmortem ticket.

ben: initiating promote to previous digest: `POST /internal/deploy/promote { from: "sha256:abc123def456", to: "release/rc3" }`

deploy-bot: promote accepted. starting cutover at 1719991400.

deploy-bot: promote completed — canaries 3/3 healthy :white_check_mark:. Rollback/pin applied.

release-coordinator: holding the release. rollout to prod blocked until artifact verification root cause fixed. scheduled re-release for next change window (scheduled: 1719998000). pinned release to sha256:abc123def456 and created ticket INF-452 for investigation.

ada: thanks. tagging eng-oncall and eng-infra. please preserve original artifacts and logs for forensics.

ben: uploaded CI logs & artifacts to gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/1719991110/ and attached to INF-452. saved original digest manifest.

dmitri: adding a temporary retry in verify job (3x) for EOFs to reduce noisy failures while infra digs in.

cara: I'll revert the signer rotation patch in staging and re-run end-to-end push tests.

ada: summary — immediate action: promote previous digest and hold release (done). follow-ups: INF-452 (artifact integrity + signer audit), retry hardening for verify job, re-run pushes in staging before next window.

ben: any objections?

release-coordinator: none. closing thread.
